Account Settings

A direct line to your provider.

Mail Wizard is an email client. It connects to your existing account, without a Mail Wizard server. It does not issue email addresses.

Fastmail supports direct browser connections. Other JMAP providers must allow CORS. Sending requires submission permissions. Tokens stay in your encrypted local vault.

TLS certificate validation is always on. Providers that require OAuth instead of app passwords, including Microsoft 365, are not supported by this initial desktop connector.

Encrypts your credentials, cached mail and drafts on this device. You will need it to unlock the app. It cannot be recovered by Mail Wizard. Local encryption is not end-to-end email encryption.

Composition & sending

Mail is held in this app until the countdown ends. Keep the app open. Once handed to your provider, a message cannot be recalled.

Install from your browser menu when available. On iPhone or iPad, use Share → Add to Home Screen.

Local storage & backup

Mail and drafts are stored on this device. Connected accounts use an AES-GCM encrypted vault. No analytics, advertising scripts or remote email images.

Backups include account credentials when an account is connected. Encrypted backups keep them encrypted. Existing backups and other devices are not affected by local changes. Sample backups contain fictional data only.
